# Navigator

> Learn from the greats — and the ones who built beside them.

Navigator is an open, no-login learning studio for how the world's greatest people and companies think, build, and decide — with usable tools, deep guides, and a living newsletter. Free for leaders, employees, students, and managers in every industry.

Open, no-login educational library. Sections:
- /mental-models/ decision lenses (~1045)
- /decision-tools/ 44 methods
- /business-models/ /frameworks/ /moats/ strategy
- /books/ /reading-lists/ /guides/ /quotes/ learning
- /tools/ interactive tools
- /newsletter/ weekly breakdowns
Contact: wvijay@icloud.com
